Container.Name: gmod-addon-webhook
Container.Overview: Receives GitHub push webhooks from private Garry's Mod addon repos and git-pulls the matching addon directory. Configure addons in config/addons.json. Requires a private GHCR login on this Unraid box since the image is private (see Docker > Registry in Unraid, or docker login ghcr.io on the CLI, using a GitHub PAT with read:packages).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the webhook server listens on. Point your GitHub webhooks (and any reverse proxy) at this.

Config.Name: Webhook Secret
Config.Description: Shared secret used to verify GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256 header. Must match the secret set on each addon repo's webhook.

Config.Name: Reload Token
Config.Description: Token required to call POST /reload-config to pick up addons.json changes without restarting the container.

Config.Name: Git SSH Command
Config.Description: SSH command used for git fetch/clone, pointing at the mounted deploy key below.

Config.Name: Addons Config
Config.Description: JSON file listing each addon: repo, url, path, branch. See addons.example.json in the repo.

Config.Name: Deploy Key
Config.Description: Read-only SSH private key (deploy key) used to git pull/clone the private addon repos.

Config.Name: GMod Addons Directory
Config.Description: Mount your actual GMod server's addons directory here — paths in addons.json should live under this.
